comment: Nuxel charger/LPM boot-mode guard (briq-01c). Userspace only: it classifies the
current boot, publishes the state to the launcher, and can request ONE gated
normal reboot. It never writes a partition, a bootloader, a DTB or a modem.
The permanent fix for 'an LPM power-up has no touchscreen' is a kernel change
reason_allow_reboot_false: allow_reboot is false in the config: touch is disabled on this boot and this device is not in an automatic-reboot configuration - unplug and reboot normally
enable_auto_reboot: To let the guard perform the reboot itself, set "allow_reboot": true here AND
nuxel-bootmode-reboot.service, shipped disabled). The acknowledgement flag is
deliberate: a config edit alone must not be enough to reboot the phone.
